subject: Quick update and my calendar mix-up
text: Hi, Just wanted to give you a quick update on the signage prep. I got everything boxed, but I totally misread the calendar entry for tomorrow's walkthrough. I thought it was 9 a.m., when it was clearly listed at 1 p.m. No worries. I'll be at the new time and bring the extra tape. The inventory sheet is done, and I'm still good on the rest. Let me know if anything else pops up. Sorry for the scramble and thanks for your patience, too. Cheers,
